question: For each country containing at least 5 airports, report the country name, total airport count, number whose recorded type is exactly 'major', and the percentage of airports classified as 'major'. Sort by total airport count descending.
sql: SELECT c.name AS country_name, COUNT(*) AS airport_count, SUM(CASE WHEN a.type = 'major' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS major_airport_count, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.type = 'major' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS major_airport_pct FROM countries AS c JOIN airports AS a ON ST_Intersects(c.geometry, a.geometry) GROUP BY c.iso_a3, c.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY airport_count DESC, country_name;

question: Which countries covering at least 10,000 km² of land have an airport density of at least 0.5 airports per 100,000 km²? Return the country name, land area in km², airport count, and airport density per 100,000 km².
sql: WITH country_stats AS (SELECT c.iso_a3, c.name, COUNT(*) AS airport_count, ST_Area(ST_Transform(c.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:6933', always_xy := true)) / 1000000.0 AS land_area_km2 FROM countries AS c JOIN airports AS a ON ST_Intersects(c.geometry, a.geometry) GROUP BY c.iso_a3, c.name, c.geometry) SELECT name AS country_name, ROUND(land_area_km2, 0) AS land_area_km2, airport_count, ROUND(airport_count * 100000.0 / land_area_km2, 2) AS airports_per_100k_km2 FROM country_stats WHERE land_area_km2 >= 10000 AND airport_count * 100000.0 / land_area_km2 >= 0.5 ORDER BY airports_per_100k_km2 DESC, country_name;

question: For each continent with at least 10 countries containing at least one airport and a combined population of at least 100 million, report the number of airport-hosting countries and their total population in millions.
sql: WITH airport_hosting_countries AS (SELECT c.iso_a3, c.name, c.continent, c.pop_est FROM countries AS c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM airports AS a WHERE ST_Intersects(c.geometry, a.geometry))) SELECT continent, COUNT(*) AS airport_hosting_countries, ROUND(SUM(pop_est) / 1000000.0, 1) AS total_population_millions FROM airport_hosting_countries GROUP BY continent HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 AND SUM(pop_est) >= 100000000 ORDER BY airport_hosting_countries DESC, continent;

question: For each region, how many airports have the recorded type exactly 'major', and what is the combined GDP of the countries containing those airports, counting each country once? Report GDP in USD millions and include only regions with at least 3 such airports and combined GDP of at least USD 100,000 million.
sql: WITH country_major AS (SELECT c.region_un, c.iso_a3, c.name, NULLIF(c.gdp_md, -99) AS gdp_usd_millions, COUNT(*) AS major_airports FROM countries AS c JOIN airports AS a ON ST_Intersects(c.geometry, a.geometry) WHERE a.type = 'major' GROUP BY c.region_un, c.iso_a3, c.name, c.gdp_md), region_stats AS (SELECT region_un, SUM(major_airports) AS major_airports, SUM(gdp_usd_millions) AS gdp_usd_millions FROM country_major GROUP BY region_un) SELECT region_un, major_airports, gdp_usd_millions FROM region_stats WHERE major_airports >= 3 AND gdp_usd_millions >= 100000 ORDER BY gdp_usd_millions DESC, region_un;

question: Among European countries with at least 3 airports, calculate the mean and maximum straight-line distance from the airports to the country's geometric centroid. Include only countries whose mean distance is no more than 500 km, and report distances in kilometres.
sql: WITH projected AS (SELECT c.iso_a3, c.name, ST_Transform(a.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:6933', always_xy := true) AS airport_m, ST_Transform(ST_Centroid(c.geometry), 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:6933', always_xy := true) AS centroid_m FROM countries AS c JOIN airports AS a ON ST_Intersects(c.geometry, a.geometry) WHERE c.region_un = 'Europe'), distances AS (SELECT iso_a3, name, ST_Distance(airport_m, centroid_m) / 1000.0 AS distance_km FROM projected) SELECT name AS country_name, COUNT(*) AS airport_count, ROUND(AVG(distance_km), 1) AS mean_distance_km, ROUND(MAX(distance_km), 1) AS max_distance_km FROM distances GROUP BY iso_a3, name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 AND AVG(distance_km) <= 500 ORDER BY mean_distance_km DESC, country_name;

question: For each country with at least 2 airports in total, count the airports lying no more than 50 km from the boundary of the country's mapped polygon, including coastlines, and report that count and its share of all airports. Include only countries with at least 1 such airport.
sql: WITH airport_boundary_distances AS (SELECT c.iso_a3, c.name, ST_Transform(a.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:6933', always_xy := true) AS airport_m, ST_Transform(ST_Boundary(c.geometry), 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:6933', always_xy := true) AS boundary_m FROM countries AS c JOIN airports AS a ON ST_Intersects(c.geometry, a.geometry)), country_stats AS (SELECT iso_a3, name, COUNT(*) AS total_airports, SUM(CASE WHEN ST_Distance(airport_m, boundary_m) / 1000.0 <= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS near_boundary_airports FROM airport_boundary_distances GROUP BY iso_a3, name) SELECT name AS country_name, total_airports, near_boundary_airports, ROUND(100.0 * near_boundary_airports / NULLIF(total_airports, 0), 1) AS near_boundary_pct FROM country_stats WHERE total_airports >= 2 AND near_boundary_airports >= 1 ORDER BY near_boundary_airports DESC, country_name;
